# Step 55: 2½" wire from eyelet #2 (S) to V3 pin 6 (S)

> *Connect one end of a 2 ½" wire to eyelet #2 (S). Connect the other end to pin #6 of V3 (S).* — manual page 10

## What you're doing physically

A 2½" wire from PC-3 eyelet #2 to V3 pin 6. Both ends soldered.

V3 pin 6 now has: the 1 kΩ grid stopper from step 37 + this wire. Soldered final.

## What this is

Mirror of [step 39](step-39-eyelet-23-to-v6.md) but for channel B. Eyelet #2 is one of the **phase-splitter outputs** of the channel B 6GH8A. This wire delivers the cathodyne audio signal (via on-board coupling cap) to V3's grid through the grid stopper.
